song_notes: Hymne à l'amour and Pour que tu m'aimes encore are the French-page songs; the English songs are used on both pages.
rules: Normal edit: only the hook changes (sometimes the rehook). Body, end clip, caption style and song placement come from the template.

Hook longer or shorter than the template: the tool ripples the timeline. Body and CTA move, the hook caption stretches, the song starts earlier (music box, handoff fixed) or runs longer (no end sound).
Store-claim hooks (RUN to <STORE>, <BRAND> x <STORE>, '<STORE> just collabed') pair with the reveal CTA (JK / Just JOKING / Je rigole). Every other hook pairs with the plain CTA.
Use the store the hook clip actually shows (TARGET / WALMART / COSTCO / LECLERC / CARREFOUR).
workflow: Ali, 2026-10-08: each timeline in the CapCut project is named after its song and already holds that song cut to the right section. Picking the song = picking the timeline (US: 6 English timelines; FR: French, French 2, Timeline 14). Then swap the hook and set the caption style. Body clips never change. Shorter hook: cut the start of the song and the caption, slide everything left. Longer hook: extend the song and the caption at the start. (capcut_draft.py does exactly that.)
songs_note_us: US: the song is chosen by choosing the timeline (each timeline keeps Ali's own cut of its song). The music library is only needed for a song that has no timeline yet.
mix: Keep each song timeline exactly as Ali mixed it (song and raw volumes untouched). The 10.9 dB raw-under-song rule only applies when a song is swapped in from the music library.
